name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.183.0 — The review driver no longer parks a CLEAN close at REPLAY: DONE follows MERGE directly every time, the replay-recorded mark and its REPLAY state are deleted (spec-review-driver.js, spec/scripts/lib/parse-selection.js and its test removed), and replay dueness moves into the shared ledger library (lib/observation.js's replayDueness, shared by replay.js --due and the dashboard) alongside a new specs-done-since-last-release derivation (sinceLastRelease). /spec:status's footer now shows a `· N done since last release` or `· N done, never released` clause plus a `· replay due (r/5) — /spec:replay` clause, both ignorable and neither ever blocking anything — /spec:replay is the sole executor. docs/adr/0025 records the reversal: a block on an already-finished review is bypassed anyway, and the earlier printed-reminder measurement (12+ skipped reviews) is now why dueness lives on the dashboard instead of in a report. 7.182.0 — Silence is not a pass (specs/20260913/08): a release leg that measured nothing — ci with no adapter or an unseen sha, ci still in progress, a declined production promotion, a substrate manifest of only inert rows — now derives UNVERIFIED on the release profile via one shared derivation (lib/release-unmeasured.js); release-legs.js stage prints a ⚪ glyph and an UNMEASURED: line and exits 1 so /spec:release stops before promotion. Genesis now makes brief 01 the first-light brief: genesis-driver refuses roadmap-written until brief 01 names its First light: record. 7.181.0 — The critic is out: the mocks chain now derives THEME straight off a fully approved WIREFRAMES stage, retiring the fresh-context critic pass and its ledger-pinned question producer end to end — the retired mark, reopen target, ask subcommand and answer route are all refused as unknown inputs now, the critic agent and its two dispatch sites are gone, and an assumption row is confirmed or overridden only by the human-run `ledger set`. A note a person did not type stays on disk but is never listed, grouped, counted or gated on again, and the composer's reason chips are retired in the same stroke — the textarea grows to fill the freed height.
